chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Safwan from Hammad ibn 'Uthman said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about entering the House, so he said: 'As for the Sarrur, he enters it, and as for whoever has performed Hajj, he does not.'

key_terms.اَلصَّرُورَةُ: Al-Sarrur (a specific person or title mentioned in the ruling)

ai.seo_question: Who is allowed to enter the Kaaba according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the distinction between the general prohibition of entering the Kaaba and the specific exception for 'al-Sarrur', a title often associated with the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) or a unique historical status, while excluding those who have already completed Hajj. This ruling highlights the nuanced juristic understanding of the Kaaba's sanctity and the specific conditions under which entry is permitted beyond the ritual circumambulation.
